# WorkInPrivate

> WorkInPrivate is a desktop AI chat app for Windows, macOS, and Linux that runs open-source AI models entirely on the user's own computer. Chats and files stay on the machine: no cloud, no account, and nothing is used to train AI. It is aimed at non-technical people and professionals who handle confidential material.

## Key facts

- Price: $49.99 one-time purchase, no subscription.
- Free trial: 7 days, full features, no account, no credit card, no email.
- Platforms: Windows 10 or later, macOS 12 or later (Apple Silicon only), Linux.
- Requirements: 8 GB RAM minimum (16 GB recommended), about 5 GB free disk space. A GPU is optional.
- Setup: a guided installer checks the computer's hardware and recommends a model. No command line.
- Models: open-source models downloaded from Hugging Face.
- Works offline after setup.
- Features: ChatGPT-style chat, chat with your own documents, file analysis.
- Licence: one key per computer, unlocks the app permanently.
- Publisher: Wallco Digital Labs LLC. Support: support@workinprivate.com
